I am a PhD candidate in Economics at the University of Example. My research interests lie at the intersection of development economics, public economics, and political economy.
My research examines how public policies and institutions affect economic opportunities, household welfare, and local economic development.
I will be on the academic job market in 2026–27.






Abstract
This paper studies how large-scale public infrastructure investment affects local economic activity, employment, and household welfare. Using administrative data combined with geospatial measures of infrastructure exposure, I estimate the causal effects of infrastructure expansion on local economic outcomes.
